statement: Tropical endpoint-gap shape theorem. For a non-singleton positive mask E={e_0<...<e_k}, let g_-(E)=e_1-e_0 and g_+(E)=e_k-e_(k-1). These are Laurent-translation invariant and obey g_-(AB)=min(g_-(A),g_-(B)), g_+(AB)=min(g_+(A),g_+(B)) for actual positive products. On either scalar-sign class, the normalized source pair (g_-/w,g_+/w)(lambda_jX) is constant (with a sign-induced swap) independently of zero/nonzero anchors. In the actual common-spectrum block P_V=P_Aj P_(lambda_jX), put L=g_-(V), R=g_+(V). Simultaneous feasibility and distinct same-sign scalar magnitudes imply that the union of the equality walls g_-(lambda_jX)=L and g_+(lambda_jX)=R contains at most one actual row. After deleting it, on a subfamily J* of size at least |J_sigma|-1=t^(5/9-o(1)), every complement satisfies (g_-(A_j),g_+(A_j))=(L,R). Hence the combined normalized-source/raw-complement non-affine profile has exact range one on J*.
